rows.text: takes the top three bits of byte `rcx+3` (`shr 5`) and the larger of `xmm1` and 0.01 (`008F30E4`, `maxss`); when the bits equal 1 it stores that float to `+0x70` of qword `rcx+0xB8`, when they equal 3 to `+0xFC` of the same qword, and for any other value it returns without a store

when the top three bits of byte `rcx+3` (`shr 5`) equal 1, clears bit 3 of byte `rcx+0xD` (`AND 0xF7`) and ORs bit 0 of `dl`, shifted left by 3, back into it; for any other value it returns without a write

switches on the top three bits of byte `rcx+3` (`shr 5`): for 1 it stores `xmm1`, `xmm2` and `xmm3` to floats `+0x10`, `+0x14` and `+0x18` of qword `rcx+0xB8`; for 3 it subtracts floats `+0`, `+4` and `+8` of that qword from `xmm1`, `xmm2` and `xmm3` and tail-jumps (`0026BB00` + 0x26) with `rcx` unchanged; for any other value it returns without a write
when the top three bits of byte `rcx+3` (`shr 5`) equal 1, stores `xmm1`, `xmm2` and `xmm3` to floats `+0x20`, `+0x24` and `+0x28` of qword `rcx+0xB8`; for any other value it returns without a write

takes the absolute values of `xmm1` and `xmm2` (widened to double, sign cleared with the mask at `01CEBD80`, narrowed back) and switches on the top three bits of byte `rcx+3` (`shr 5`): for 1 it ORs 2 into byte `+0x5D` of qword `rcx+0xB8`, stores the two values to floats `+0x30` and `+0x34`, and lowers float `+0x40` to the first and float `+0x44` to the second wherever the stored float is greater; for 3 it tail-jumps (`0026BFF0` + 0x38) with the two values in `xmm1` and `xmm2`; for any other value it returns without a write
maps `ecx` to a return value: 0 returns 3, 1 returns 2, and any other value returns 1
